summary.text: Alexander Valiensi Kent, an independent from La Crosse with a background in social work and philosophy, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Wisconsin's 3rd District to Rebecca Cooke.
He wrote a 2024 book on online voting and described his campaign as independent, voter-directed and accepting no money from donors.

paragraphs.text: Kent lives in La Crosse, Wisconsin. He earned a bachelor's degree from Viterbo University in 2014 and a graduate degree from the University of Chicago in 2016.

He describes his background as social work and philosophy, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as social work. His 2024 book, "Voter Directed Democracy," is, in his description, a political theory about bringing democratic republicanism online.
He received 1.2% of the vote to Rebecca Cooke's 52.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
